meals.name: One-Pot Lemon Chicken and Rice
meals.description: Tender chicken thighs simmered with fluffy rice, garlic and lemon in a single pot for a comforting, easy supper.

meals.name: Creamy Chicken and Rice Soup
meals.description: A thick, warming soup full of chicken, carrot, celery and rice, perfect for dunking bread on a wet evening.

meals.name: Baked Chicken and Tomato Rice with Peppers
meals.description: Chicken drumsticks roast over rice cooked in a spiced tomato sauce with sweet peppers, all in one tray with minimal washing up.

meals.name: One-Pot Lemon Chicken and Rice
meals.description: Tender chicken thighs simmered with fluffy rice, sweet carrots and peas in a gently lemony stock. A comforting one-pot supper with very little washing up.

meals.name: Creamy Chicken and Rice Soup
meals.description: A thick, warming soup full of shredded chicken, rice and soft vegetables, finished with a swirl of cream. Perfect for dunking bread on a wet evening.

meals.name: Baked Chicken and Rice Casserole with Broccoli
meals.description: Chicken pieces and rice baked together in a creamy, cheesy sauce with broccoli, finished with a golden cheese topping. Pure comfort straight from the oven.

meals.name: One-Pot Lemon Chicken and Rice
meals.description: Tender chicken thighs simmered with fluffy rice, lemon and peas in a single pot for a comforting, easy supper.

meals.name: Creamy Chicken and Rice Soup
meals.description: A warming, velvety soup packed with shredded chicken, carrot, celery and rice, perfect for a chilly, rainy evening.

meals.name: Baked Chicken and Tomato Rice with Peppers
meals.description: Chicken drumsticks roasted over smoky paprika rice with sweet peppers and tomato, all cooked together in the oven.

meals.name: Peanut-Free Chicken Satay Noodle Stir-Fry
meals.description: Tender chicken, crunchy vegetables and egg noodles tossed in a rich, creamy satay-style sauce made with sunflower seed butter, so it is completely nut-free. Gently flavoured with garlic, ginger and lime, with no chilli heat.

meals.name: Creamy Satay Prawn and Rice Noodle Stir-Fry
meals.description: Juicy prawns, courgette and pak choi with silky flat rice noodles in a rich satay-style sauce made from sunflower seed butter. Finished with fresh coriander and a squeeze of lime, with no nuts and no chilli.

meals.name: Satay Tofu and Broccoli Udon Stir-Fry
meals.description: Golden pan-fried tofu, broccoli and mushrooms with thick, chewy udon noodles, coated in a rich, savoury satay sauce made from sunflower seed butter and a touch of sesame oil. Vegetarian, nut-free and mild.

meals.name: Chicken Satay Noodle Stir-Fry
meals.description: Tender chicken, crunchy vegetables and egg noodles tossed in a rich, creamy satay-style sauce made with sunflower seed butter, so it's completely nut-free. Gently spiced with mild curry powder, so it's kid-friendly.

meals.name: Prawn and Rice Noodle Stir-Fry with Creamy Satay Sauce
meals.description: Juicy prawns, pak choi and silky rice noodles coated in a glossy, savoury-sweet satay sauce with a hint of paprika for gentle warmth. A light, quick supper with scrambled egg folded through for extra richness.

meals.name: Crispy Tofu and Vegetable Udon with Satay Sauce
meals.description: Golden pan-fried tofu and plenty of colourful vegetables stirred through thick, chewy udon noodles in a rich, creamy satay-style sauce. A hearty vegetarian dinner with a mild, family-friendly flavour.

meals.name: Chicken Satay Noodle Stir-Fry
meals.description: Tender strips of chicken and crunchy vegetables tossed with rice noodles in a rich, creamy nut-free satay sauce made with sunflower seed butter, soy and lime. Mild enough for the kids.

meals.name: Prawn Satay Egg Noodles with Pak Choi
meals.description: Juicy prawns, pak choi and sugar snap peas stir-fried with egg noodles in a glossy, savoury-sweet satay-style sauce. It is mildly spiced with sweet paprika and nut-free.

meals.name: Crispy Tofu and Veg Satay Udon
meals.description: Golden pan-fried tofu, mushrooms, courgette and spinach with thick udon noodles in a rich tahini-based satay sauce. Creamy, savoury and entirely nut-free and vegetarian.

meals.name: Summer Fish and Pea Paella
meals.description: A classic-style paella with flaky hake, sweet red pepper and peas, scented with saffron and smoked paprika, with a squeeze of lemon on top. It is made without shellfish but still tastes of the Spanish coast.

meals.name: Salmon and Courgette Paella
meals.description: A golden, turmeric-tinted rice cooked in a wide frying pan with chunks of salmon, tender courgette and crisp green beans. It is a light, colourful dish for a warm weekend.

meals.name: Oven-Baked Cod and Tomato Paella
meals.description: A hands-off paella baked in the oven with cod, sweet peppers, juicy cherry tomatoes and green olives. The rice turns rich and savoury while you relax.

meals.name: Cod and Pea Summer Paella
meals.description: A classic-style paella with flaky cod, sweet red pepper and peas, all scented with smoked paprika and saffron. Finish with a squeeze of lemon and serve straight from the pan.

meals.name: Lemony Salmon and Green Bean Paella
meals.description: A lighter, zesty one-pan rice dish with tender salmon, courgette and green beans, golden with turmeric and brightened with lemon and dill. Perfect for a relaxed summer evening.

meals.name: Smoked Haddock and Chicken Paella
meals.description: A hearty land-and-sea paella with juicy chicken thigh and smoky haddock, sweet peppers and rich tomato. Smoked paprika gives it all the depth you would normally get from chorizo.

meals.name: Hake and Pea Summer Paella
meals.description: A saffron-golden paella cooked in one pan on the hob, with flaky hake, sweet peppers and peas. Smoked paprika gives the smokiness you'd normally get from chorizo, and it's finished with lemon and parsley. It's a shellfish-free take on seafood paella.

meals.name: Oven-Baked Salmon Paella-Style Rice
meals.description: Rice baked in the oven with juicy salmon, courgette, green beans and cherry tomatoes. It's a hands-off paella for a lazy summer weekend, flavoured with smoked paprika and turmeric and finished with a squeeze of lemon.

meals.name: Cod and Tomato Fideuà (Noodle Paella)
meals.description: A Catalan-style cousin of paella made with toasted vermicelli instead of rice. It's simmered in a smoky tomato and pepper stock with chunks of cod and served with a dollop of garlicky mayonnaise.

meals.name: Vegan Mushroom Carbonara with Smoky Tofu Bacon
meals.description: Silky cashew and nutritional yeast sauce coats spaghetti, topped with crisp smoked tofu 'bacon' and plenty of black pepper. All the indulgence of a classic carbonara, completely plant-based.

meals.name: Creamy Vegan Mac and Cheese with Garlicky Broccoli
meals.description: Macaroni in a velvety, cheesy sauce made from potato, carrot and nutritional yeast, with a hint of Dijon mustard. Tender broccoli adds freshness and a little green to the plate.

meals.name: Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato and Spinach Penne
meals.description: Penne tossed in a rich, blushing sauce of blended cannellini beans, oat cream and sun-dried tomatoes, finished with wilted spinach and toasted pine nuts. Luxurious, cosy and ideal for sharing.

meals.name: Vegan Mushroom Carbonara with Smoky Tofu Bacon
meals.description: Silky cashew cream sauce with nutritional yeast and a savoury, cheesy depth, tossed through spaghetti with golden mushrooms and smoky crisp tofu lardons. Rich, glossy and made for a candlelit dinner.

meals.name: Creamy Vegan Mac and Cheese with Crispy Breadcrumbs
meals.description: Comforting macaroni in a velvety, cheesy sauce made from potato, carrot and nutritional yeast, finished with a golden garlicky breadcrumb crunch. Pure indulgence without any dairy.

meals.name: Creamy Vegan Alfredo Fettuccine with Garlic Broccoli
meals.description: Ribbons of fettuccine coated in a luscious garlic and white wine style cream sauce made with oat cream and nutritional yeast, with tender broccoli and a finish of lemon and black pepper.

meals.name: Vegan Cashew Carbonara with Smoky Mushrooms
meals.description: Silky spaghetti coated in a creamy cashew and nutritional yeast sauce, topped with crispy smoked mushroom 'bacon' and plenty of black pepper. All the indulgence of a classic carbonara, entirely plant-based.

meals.name: Creamy Vegan Mac and Cheese with Crispy Breadcrumbs
meals.description: Tender macaroni in a velvety, cheese-style sauce made from potato, carrot and nutritional yeast, finished with golden garlicky breadcrumbs for a satisfying crunch.

meals.name: Creamy Garlic Spinach and Pea Fettuccine Alfredo
meals.description: Ribbons of fettuccine in a rich, garlicky oat cream and cashew Alfredo sauce, studded with sweet peas and wilted spinach. Luxurious and elegant for a romantic evening in.

meals.name: Tofu sushikauss
meals.description: Krõbedalt praetud tofu, kreemjas avokaado ja krõmpsuv kurk sushiriisil. Kõik on kausis koos, nagu lahtivõetud sushirull.

meals.name: Kanasushirullid
meals.description: Nori lehtedesse keeratud mahlane kanafilee, avokaado ja kurk õrnalt hapukal riisil. Kana saab pannil sojakastmes läikima.

meals.name: Jaapani munarull riisiga
meals.description: Kergelt magus kihiline munarull kurgi ja sojakastmes riisiga. Muna keeratakse pannil kuldseks rulliks.

meals.name: Tofu-avokaadokauss
meals.description: Krõbedaks praetud tofu, kreemjas avokaado ja krõmpsuv kurk leotatud sushiriisil. Peale tulevad norilehe ribad ja seesam.

meals.name: Munarull riisi ja kurgiga
meals.description: Pehme kuldne munakihk keeratakse riisi, kurgi ja porgandiga noriks rulliks. Lõigatud viiludena näeb välja nagu pärast sushibaari.

meals.name: Kana-sushiburrito
meals.description: Mahlane teriyaki-kana, avokaado ja kurk riisiga nori sisse rullitud. Majoneesi ja chilikastmega on see käes söödav ja vürtsikas.

meals.name: Teriyaki kanakauss
meals.description: Kuldseks praetud kanatükid teriyakikastmes sushiriisi, krõmpsuva kurgi ja kreemja avokaadoga. Kõik läheb ühte kaussi nagu sushi, aga ilma rullimata.

meals.name: Avokaado-kurgi maki
meals.description: Käsitsi rullitud nori-rullid kreemja avokaado, krõmpsuva kurgi ja porgandiga. Pealt veidi sojakastet ja wasabit.

meals.name: Munaonigiri kurgisalatiga
meals.description: Pehmed riisipallid kreemja muna-majoneesitäidisega, noorilehes ja seesamiga. Kõrvale värske kurk.

meals.name: Ahjulõhe sparglitega
meals.description: Õrn lõhefilee sidruni ja tilliga, kõrval kuldsed ahjukartulid ja röstitud spargel. Kõik valmib ühel plaadil, nii et pidulik laud saab kiiresti kaetud.

meals.name: Spinati-rikotta lasanje
meals.description: Kihiline lasanje kreemja spinati-rikotta täidise ja tomatikastmega. Pealt kuldne ja venivaks sulanud mozzarella.

meals.name: Juustukattega tursk porruga
meals.description: Pehme tursafilee kreemja porru ja porgandi peal, pealt krõbeda juustu-riivsaiakoorikuga. Ahjus kuldseks küpsenud ja pühapäevalauale igati sobiv.

meals.name: Ahjulõhe sparglitega
meals.description: Õrn roosa lõhe sidruni ja tilliga, kõrval kuldsed ahjukartulid ja värsked sparglid. Kõik küpseb koos ühel plaadil, nii et lauale jõuab pidulik roog vähese vaevaga.

meals.name: Spinatilasanje
meals.description: Kihiline lasanje spinati, rikota ja tomatikastmega, pealt sulanud mozzarella ja parmesaniga. Ahjus tekib krõbe kuldne pealispind ja kreemjas sisu.

meals.name: Kalapirukas hernestega
meals.description: Mahlane tursk hernestega kreemjas valgekastmes, pealt kuldne kartulipüree juustukooriku all. Soe ja rahuldav pühapäevalõuna roog kogu perele.

meals.name: Ahjulõhe sparglitega
meals.description: Mahlane lõhefilee sidruni-tillivõi all, kõrval kuldsed ahjukartulid ja krõmpsuv roheline spargel. Kõik valmib ühel ahjuplaadil.

meals.name: Spinati-rikotta lasanje
meals.description: Kihiline lasanje kreemja rikotta ja spinatiga, tomatikastme ja sulanud mozzarellaga. Pealt kuldne ja kergelt krõbe.

meals.name: Täidetud paprika
meals.description: Magusad ahjupaprikad riisi, kikerherneste ja fetaga täidetud. Tomatikastmes küpsenud ja aromaatsed.

meals.name: Soe kartulisalat suitsutofuga
meals.description: Pehmed soojad kartulid kreemjas taimses hapukoores, peal kuldseks praetud suitsutofu kuubikud. Maitse on vanaemalik, kala asemel annab suitsuse noodi tofu.

meals.name: Suitsuporgandi kartulisalat
meals.description: Ahjus röstitud suitsupaprikaga porgandiribad annavad soojale kartulisalatele kala meenutava suitsuse maitse. Hapukoorekaste on kreemjas ja sinepi järelmaitsega.

meals.name: Ahjukartul suitsutofuga
meals.description: Krõbeda koorega ahjukartulid, täidetud sooja hapukoore ja suitsutofu segu ning murulaugurohelisega. Vanaema kartulisalati maitsed uues kuues.

meals.name: Soe kartulisalat suitsutofuga
meals.description: Soe kartul, kuldseks praetud suitsutofu ja kreemjas taimne hapukoor, nagu vanaema salat, aga taimse versioonina. Marineeritud kurk ja till annavad värskuse.

meals.name: Kartulisalat suitsuporganditega
meals.description: Ahjus röstitud porgand suitsupaprika ja sojakastmega annab salatile suitsuse maitse. Soe kartul ja kreemjas taimne hapukoor sobivad sinna kõrvale.

meals.name: Kartuli-kikerhernesalat noriga
meals.description: Soe kartul, mahlane kikerhernes ja kapparid taimses hapukoore981 kastmes. Nori toob lauale õrna meremaitse, mis meenutab kalasalatit.

meals.name: Kartulisalat suitsutofuga
meals.description: Soe kartulisalat hapukoorekastme, hapukurgi ja pannil kuldseks röstitud suitsutofuga. Maitseb nagu vanaema köök, aga ilma kala ja piimata.

meals.name: Soe kartuli-porgandisalat
meals.description: Ahjus kuldseks küpsenud porgand saab suitsupaprikaga kerge suitsuse maitse. Kreemjas hapukoorekaste seob selle soojade kartulitega.

meals.name: Kartuli-oasalat suitsupaprikaga
meals.description: Soe kartulisalat pehmete valgete ubade, kappari ja punase sibulaga. Hapukoorekaste ja suitsupaprika annavad sellele vanaema-salati tuttava maitse.

meals.name: Läätsebolognese spagettidega
meals.description: Pehme punaste läätsedega tomatikaste, mis tõmbab hautades paksuks ja sobib spagettidele. Peale läheb riivjuust.

meals.name: Läätse-juustuquesadillad
meals.description: Krõbedad tortillad pehme läätsetäidise, sulanud juustu ja magusa maisiga. Pannil kuldseks röstitud ja käsitsi söödav.

meals.name: Kookosene läätsekarri riisiga
meals.description: Kreemjas ja pehme karri punaste läätsede ning porgandiga, mõnusalt mahe. Serveeritud aurutatud riisi peal.

meals.name: Läätsebolognese spagettidega
meals.description: Kreemjas tomatikaste punaste läätsedega, mis hautub pehmeks ja maitseb peaaegu nagu hakklihakaste. Peale riivitud juust.

meals.name: Läätse-kookosekarri riisiga
meals.description: Pehme, õrnalt vürtsikas karri punaste läätsede ja porgandiga kookospiimas. Serveeritud kohevale riisile.

meals.name: Läätse-juustukvesadillad
meals.description: Krõbedad tortillad sulajuustu, läätsede, paprika ja maisiga. Pannil kuldseks röstitud ja hapukoorega serveeritud.

meals.name: Läätsebolognese spagettidega
meals.description: Kreemjas tomatikaste punaste läätsede ja porgandiga, mis keeb pehmeks nagu hakkliha. Spagettidele riivitakse peale juustu.

meals.name: Läätse-juustuvoldikud
meals.description: Krõbedad tortillavoldikud pehme läätse-paprikatäidise ja sulanud juustuga. Serveeri hapukoorega.

meals.name: Mahe läätsekarri riisiga
meals.description: Kookospiimas hautatud punased läätsed ja spinat, mis on pehme ja mahe maitsega. Serveeri koos aurutatud riisiga.
